name: cavemio-live-map
title: Live map
description: The world as dots, lighting up where things happen: pings ripple, the light lingers, and one card follows the newest event from city to city.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The map is decorative to assistive tech; each new event’s label and detail are announced through a polite status region.
- Points use plain latitude and longitude; the projection is a stretched equirectangular, so it reads like the maps people know without a library.
- The coastlines are deliberately coarse; at this dot size the detail wouldn’t show. Antarctica and the far north are cropped.
- Installs Text morph. With reduced motion nothing ripples, glides or draws; pings simply light their dots.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: pings
props.type: { id, lat, lon, label?, detail?, from? }[]
props.description: – · Recent events, oldest first. Each id pings once, the first time it’s seen.

props.name: markers
props.description: – · Places that are always marked, like a store or an office.

props.name: afterglow
props.description: 9000 · Milliseconds for a ping’s light to fade to its faint tint.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: true · Show the card on the newest ping.

features.title: The world as dots
features.description: Hand-drawn coastlines are sampled into an even field of dots, so there is nothing to download.

features.title: Pings from latitude and longitude
features.description: Each event lights the dots around it and sends a thin line ring rippling out.

features.title: Light that lingers
features.description: The glow fades slowly, 9 seconds by default, so recent activity stays on the map as a faint tint.

features.title: One card for the newest event
features.description: A single card glides from city to city, its words morphing, instead of popups stacking up.

features.title: Routes between places
features.description: Give an event a starting point and a curve arcs across from there, with a short dash running along it.

features.title: Markers and screen readers
features.description: Fixed places such as an office show as rings, and each new event is announced politely.

states.title: land
states.description: A staggered grid every 2.6° sampled against hand-drawn coastlines (no map data to load), drawn as one path; cropped between 76°N and 56°S.

states.title: ping
states.description: Dots within about 5° light in the primary colour, brightest at the centre; a 1px ring scales out and fades (1.4s). The light holds briefly, then fades to a faint tint over afterglow (9s by default).

states.title: card
states.description: Follows the newest ping (620ms glide); its two lines morph letter by letter; flips left near the right edge and below near the bottom.

states.title: route
states.description: With from, a curve lifted in proportion to the distance draws itself (pathLength 1), a 2px dash runs from end to end (1.5s), then the curve fades.

states.title: markers
states.description: A thin line ring with a dot in the middle, always shown.
